correctness.rationale: Every binary word of n≥3 determines an Euler trail in the binary order-two de Bruijn digraph, and conversely every nonnegative 8-vector of edge counts with nonempty weakly connected support and admissible zero or +1/−1 vertex imbalance admits a word trail. Source proof parametrizes edge flows by three free multiplicities and two loop variables. The actual verify_threegram.py was read: it enumerates each of 255 nonempty support masks, all 13 allowed imbalance patterns, applies exact connectivity and positivity constraints, and sums geometric tails as an integer polynomial identity; algebraically reduced numerator and denominator agree with displayed GF, not merely interpolation of finite coefficients. Pole structure gives order five at z=1 and uncancelled primitive 3rd, 4th and −1 roots, proving degree4 period12. The displayed numerator evaluates to 13 at z=1, so leading coefficient 13/288. Independently generated all 2^n words n=3..16, finding exactly the expected 14 profile counts (T_15=1880,T_16=2449). The finite checks alone do not prove all lengths.
